scope: Existing Wantiss TEST-MODE webhook subscription configuration and read-only impact inspection. No live-mode configuration or financial transaction accepted.

initialFinding.detail: Existing test webhook subscribed only to payment_intent.succeeded; card setup, refund and dispute events were not subscribed.

before.description: Receives successful Stripe payments for Wantiss money requests.

after.description: Receives successful Stripe payments for Wantiss money requests.

historicalTestIsolation.detail: The prior local provider run did not check pre-existing Dashboard webhooks. Stripe automatically forwarded some test events to the hosted backend as well as the local CLI receiver. The runner’s initial productionContacted:false claim did not cover that forwarding and was incorrect as an overall isolation claim.

historicalTestIsolation.remediation: The optional Stripe runner now pages through Dashboard webhook endpoints before creating any object and refuses any enabled endpoint. The Wantiss shared test account therefore cannot run further isolated financial scenarios; use a separate owner-approved Stripe sandbox with no enabled Dashboard endpoint.
